hints: Think about what functional groups ethanol and ethanoic acid have, and what special reactions and bonding each group allows.
Remember that an alcohol plus a carboxylic acid makes an ester, and both the -OH and -COOH groups can release hydrogen with sodium.
Consider the size of these two-carbon molecules and their ability to hydrogen bond with water to decide on solubility.
walkthrough:
**Check statement 1 - ester formation**

Think of esterification as a partnership. An alcohol needs a carboxylic acid, and a carboxylic acid needs an alcohol.

$$\text{CH}_3\text{COOH} + \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{OH} \rightleftharpoons \text{CH}_3\text{COOCH}_2\text{CH}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Check statement 2 - reaction with sodium**

Both the alcohol -OH and the acid -COOH contain acidic hydrogen that sodium can displace to give hydrogen gas. Ethanol reacts steadily, ethanoic acid reacts more vigorously.

$$2\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{OH} + 2\text{Na} \rightarrow 2\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{ONa} + \text{H}_2$$
$$2\text{CH}_3\text{COOH} + 2\text{Na} \rightarrow 2\text{CH}_3\text{COONa} + \text{H}_2$$

**Check statement 3 - solubility in water**

Both molecules are small (only 2 carbons) and both can form hydrogen bonds with water through their oxygen atoms and OH groups. So both dissolve readily.

Conclusion: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are all correct.

options.A: Correct. All three statements are true. Esterification uses both types of compound, both liberate H2 with Na, and both short-chain molecules H-bond well with water.
options.B: Incorrect because it leaves out statement 3. Students sometimes think only ethanol is soluble, but ethanoic acid is also fully miscible with water due to hydrogen bonding.
options.C: Incorrect because it leaves out statement 1. Students sometimes think only the acid forms the ester, forgetting that the alcohol is the essential partner that supplies the alkyl group.
options.D: Incorrect because it leaves out statements 2 and 3. Students sometimes think only acids react with sodium, forgetting that alcohols also react to give an alkoxide and hydrogen.
